description.value:
Always on (automated): +1 to Herb and Medicine checks.

Bonus Action (once per scene): your next Herb and Medicine check before the end of your turn gains a further +1.

Treatment (automated): use the item on a creature within reach to roll 1d4 healing; press Apply Healing on the Chat Card.

Reskin freely as training, a perk, an implant, a technique, a gadget or a power.
